role: cross-solver comparison of the touching conductive-film (C8 contact) case: evidence printed in fdtd-conductive-contact.md, not acceptance

references.build: pymeep conda-forge nompi_py312h1c86e9f_101 (no MPI), Python 3.12.15, NumPy 2.5.4

install.command: micromamba create -n meep -c conda-forge python=3.12 pymeep=1.34.0=nompi*

references.settings: public API only. Axes (X, Y, Z) = (y, z, x): a 2-D cell with one periodic pixel along X, propagation along Y, kz_2d="complex" carrying the transverse wavenumber exactly; Courant 0.2/sqrt(3); Medium(epsilon, D_conductivity = sigma/epsilon), whose epsilon(f) equals the target at the three frequencies; PML(0.3, R_asymptotic 1e-12) with the default profile; a CustomSource electric current sheet on Ez with the stated waveform. Fields read with get_field_point at exact Ez nodes each step and transformed here as dt sum E exp(+i omega t); add_dft_fields was not used. Run script sha256 bd233d525deca77580c7923c276480db634ac13932806c70d24dcb7e783f5e87
references.discretization: 80 pixels per L0; meep and meep_unsmoothed have Ez nodes on the Wavebit E nodes (interfaces at grid phase 0.375), meep_shifted has them half a cell away; subpixel averaging on except meep_unsmoothed

references.build: pip wheel, JAX 0.11.2 on the CPU with float64, NumPy 2.4.6, Python 3.12.3

install.command: python -m pip install fdtdx==0.6.3 jax==0.11.2 jaxlib==0.11.2

references.settings: public objects. 1 x 1 x 245 cells; x Bloch boundary with the transverse wavenumber in rad/m (a ghost-cell phase, so the transverse derivative is discrete: effective kx = (2/dx) sin(kx dx/2)), y periodic; courant_factor 0.2; UniformMaterialObject per voxel with electric_conductivity = eps0 c sigma/L0, L0 = 1 um; CPML 24 cells, sigma order 3 for 1e-12 at normal incidence, kappa 1; a PointDipoleSource electric current on Ex with the stated waveform; FieldDetector(exact_interpolation=False) raw Ex each step, transformed here as for Meep. Run script sha256 b400dc6c9512894548584295a021597a1a6eca2a726d3dde75164d10289e7401. Version 0.6.2 gave the same r and t within 4e-14
references.discretization: uniform Yee grid, 80 cells per L0, voxel staircase with the film interfaces on Ex nodes (grid phase 0; the 0.375 phase of the other runs cannot be represented)

references.build: source checkout at the product commit below, NumPy backend, complex128
references.settings: tests/fixtures/fdtd/conductive_contact.py measure(n=80, pol="p", fraction=.375, periods=60 and 120): the current PlaneWave launch (differentiated two-node current), Diffraction monitors, PML(cells=24, reflection=1e-12), Courant 0.2
references.discretization: uniform Yee grid, 80 cells per L0, grid phase 0.375, the contact route's union memory

references.build: the unpublished candidate of the contact route (later landed unchanged on main as 84f4824a6a57 and fa73a94e7d6b), NumPy 2.5.1, Python 3.12.9, complex128
references.settings: the same fixture and settings with the historical hard-source PlaneWave launch of 2026-10-18; values after 41570 and 83139 steps as stored by the original campaign
references.discretization: uniform Yee grid, 80 cells per L0, grid phase 0.375, the contact route's union memory

generator.command: python freeze_public_golden.py golden_c8_contact_cross_solver.json (assembles the scored Meep and FDTDX results, the stored hard-source Wavebit values and a fresh run of the product fixture)

environment.python: 3.12.15 (Meep), 3.12.3 (FDTDX and the current Wavebit run), 3.12.9 (historical Wavebit run)
environment.os: Linux x86_64, CPU only, for the external tools and the current Wavebit run; macOS for the historical Wavebit run

cost.wall_clock: Meep 7 to 8 s per run, FDTDX 18 to 20 s, Wavebit 23 s (60 periods) and 44 s (120 periods), one process at a time on 4 CPUs

inputs.case: two touching conductive films in vacuum: eps 4 / sigma 8 on z in [-0.125, 0] above eps 2.25 / sigma 4 on [-0.25, -0.125], lengths in L0, eps*(omega) = eps + i sigma/omega with omega in c/L0; incidence along -z on a fixed transverse wavenumber kx = 2 pi sin(35 deg)/L0, p polarization
inputs.pulse: Gaussian envelope times sine, centre frequency 1, df 0.1, start cutoff 1e-6
inputs.absorber: 24 cells (0.3 L0) at both z ends, each tool's own profile designed for 1e-12
inputs.observables: complex r_p = -E_x,reflected/E_x,incident at z = 0 and t = E_x(z = -0.25)/E_x,incident(z = 0); the empty run of each band normalizes it

oracles.source: fixed-kx characteristic matrix of the continuum stack, as tests/fixtures/fdtd/conductive_contact.py computes it; an independent transfer-matrix script reproduced it to 2e-16

inputs.keys: tool__quantity with quantity r or t; each holds {"60": ..., "120": ...}, lists of [re, im] at the three wavelengths after that many periods. meep is eps_averaging on with Ez nodes on the Wavebit E nodes, meep_unsmoothed is eps_averaging off on the same grid, meep_shifted is eps_averaging on with the grid moved half a cell; wavebit is the current PlaneWave launch, wavebit_hard the historical hard-source launch

outcomes.matched: films, transverse wavenumber, polarization, wavelengths, cell size, time step (to 2e-19), pulse waveform, absorber thickness and design reflection, durations; ratios against each tool's own empty run; plane shifts by each tool's numerical vacuum wavenumber, no phase fitting
outcomes.not_matched: source mechanism (soft current sheets in Meep and FDTDX, Wavebit's plane-wave launch); absorber profiles; material interface treatment (Wavebit union memory, Meep subpixel averaging of epsilon but not of the loss, FDTDX voxel staircase); FDTDX grid phase and its discrete transverse derivative
outcomes.reference_self_check: the incident amplitude from the two nodes beside z = 0 agrees with the one from the transmission plane to 1.9e-5 (Meep) and 2.2e-6 (FDTDX); Meep's neighbouring-node wavenumber differs from the dispersion formula by up to 6.5e-4 with a complex part that does not fall with resolution, consistent with an absorber reflection of amplitude 2e-5 to 3e-5; both tools approach the reference on 160 and 320 cells per L0
outcomes.failed_or_discarded: nothing discarded. The first Meep batch had its Ez nodes half a cell from the Wavebit nodes and is kept as meep_shifted. Meep add_dft_fields monitors in this one-pixel kz_2d cell returned values that barely change with position and were not used
outcomes.not_run: df 0.07 values and the resolution ladders are not in this payload; s polarization and other grid phases were not run in the external tools; no external tool was rerun for this freeze

not_recorded.values_sha256: a nested JSON payload has no values digest (tests/references/_reference_records.py)
